session.unconfirmedTitle: The session check did not finish.

session.endedLine: Sign in again and your mail is here.

session.unconfirmedLine: Your mailbox has not been opened.
session.storageRefused: This browser does not keep them between reloads: a private window, or storage that is full.
session.noUndoHere: No undo — this browser cannot keep one.
session.refusedOwnerAbsent: This browser lost track of which account this window is for. Reload the page and try again.
session.refusedOwnerSignedOut: A sign-out is still pending on this browser. Sign in again to use this window.
session.refusedOwnerMismatch: This window is for a different account than this browser now holds.
session.refusedSessionUnchecked: Your sign-in could not be checked just now. Try again in a moment.
session.refusedOffline: We could not reach ohmail. Check your connection and try again.
session.refusedUnconfigured: This build is not connected to an ohmail server.
session.refusedNotOurs: That answer was not for this account, so it was discarded. This window is no longer confirmed for it.
session.sessionBusy: ohmail: another tab is finishing a sign-in or sign-out — try that again in a moment
session.passkeyDismissedHint: The passkey prompt was dismissed. You can try again, or use an authenticator app instead.

login.title: Sign in
login.badCredentials: That email and password didn't match. Check both and try again.
login.signInSlowed: Sign-in to this email address is slowed after many failed attempts from different places. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts from this device. Wait fifteen minutes and try again.
login.badCode: That code didn't work. Codes expire quickly — try the newest one.
login.badPasskey: That passkey wasn't accepted. Try again, or use another method.
login.totpLabel: Six-digit code from your authenticator app

setup.title: Set up your ohmail server
setup.account: I’m <name>,</name> at <email>,</email> with a password of <password></password>.
setup.tokenFine: Run it on the machine the server runs on. The token is in a framed block near the end of the log, and a restart prints a new one.
setup.badToken: That token was not accepted. Each one works once and a restart replaces it, so copy the newest from the server log.
setup.tokenSpent: This setup token was already used for {email}. To use another email address, restart the server for a new token and start again.
setup.signInHere: This is your sign-in for this server, not a new email address.
setup.settledTitle: This server is already set up.
setup.settledBody: Open your invite link if someone invited you, or sign in.
setup.unreachableBody: Check that it is running, then try again.

join.inviteMissing: Paste the code from your invite mail to continue.
join.totpQrAria: QR code for your authenticator app
join.totpCopyFailed: Copying did not work here. Type the key into your app instead.
join.codesCopyFailed: Copying did not work here. Download them or write them down.
join.codesFileHeader: ohmail recovery codes. Each one signs you in once.
join.codesElsewhere: This account already has recovery codes, made in another tab or by an earlier try. A new set would cancel them, so none is made here. If you do not have them, replace them in Settings → Security once setup is done.
join.accountChanged: This browser is now signed in as {email}. Nothing was created or changed here, because it would belong to that account and not to the one you started. Finish or close the other tab, then reload this page.
join.accountConflict: This browser has been signed in as another account since you started. Nothing was created or changed. Finish or close the other tab, then reload this page.
join.step_mailbox_lead: ohmail organizes a mailbox you already own, in place — real folders on your real server. Nothing is copied to a new address.
join.mailboxUserPlaceholder: usually the same as the address
join.appPasswordHint: Stored encrypted, used only to reach this mailbox, and revocable at your provider at any time.
join.mailboxMicrosoftRefused: Microsoft refused that password. Sign in with Microsoft instead: there is no app password to make.
join.mailboxMicrosoftAfterSetup: This server connects Microsoft mailboxes by signing in with Microsoft, in Settings → Mailboxes once setup is done. An app password works here too, where your account allows one.
join.mailboxOauth_state_invalid: That Microsoft sign-in is no longer valid, so nothing was connected. Connect with Microsoft again.
join.mailboxOauth_state_expired: That Microsoft sign-in took too long, so nothing was connected. Connect with Microsoft again.
join.mailboxOauth_account_mismatch: That Microsoft sign-in was started for another ohmail account than the one this browser is signed in to now, so nothing was connected.
join.mailboxOauth_provider_unavailable: Microsoft could not be reached, so nothing was connected. Try again in a moment.
join.mailboxOauth_exchange_failed: Microsoft did not finish the sign-in, so nothing was connected. Connect with Microsoft again, or use an app password instead.
join.mailboxOauth_no_refresh_token: Microsoft did not grant the lasting access ohmail needs to keep this mailbox in sync, so nothing was connected. Use an app password instead, or do this later.
join.mailboxOauth_no_address: Microsoft did not say which mailbox signed in, so nothing was connected. Connect with Microsoft again.
join.mailboxOauth_oauth_unconfigured: Signing in with Microsoft is not available here right now, so nothing was connected. Use an app password instead, or do this later.
join.planLaterHint: Your account is kept, and the trial waits until you start it.
join.expiredTitle: That took a little too long
join.expired: Sign in with the email address and password you just chose, and setup picks up where you left off.
join.planUnavailable: There is no account page to open from here yet. Nothing is lost — come back to this step later.
join.planPending: This account is not showing as active yet. Reload this page in a moment — nothing is lost.
join.stepUpExpired: For your security, connecting a mailbox needs a second factor you used in the last few minutes, and that window has closed. Sign in again and the setup carries on from the mailbox step.
join.appPasswordReady: Making an app password can take a while. If it takes more than a few minutes, we ask for your passkey or authenticator code once more before connecting, and everything you typed stays here.
join.inviteRequiredAfterAll: This server is still asking for an invite code. If you have one, paste it here; otherwise write to support@ohmail.app and we will sort it out.
join.inviteRequiredAfterAllSelfHost: This server is still asking for an invite code. If you have one, paste it here; otherwise ask the person who runs this server for one.
join.refusedEmail: This address is not complete. Check the part after the @, for example gmail.com.
join.refusedPassword: The password needs at least 12 characters, and at most 1024.
join.refusedTooMany: Too many signups from this connection. Wait a few minutes and try again.
join.refusedTaken: There is already an ohmail account for this address. Sign in instead.
join.refusedUnavailable: Open signup is not available on this server right now. An invite code still works; otherwise try again later.
join.refusedFull: Join the list and we let you in as soon as a place opens.
join.inviteInvalid: This invite code is for a different address. Use the address your invite mail went to, and check the code.
join.inviteUsed: Someone has signed up with this invite already. If that was you, sign in instead; if not, reply to your invite mail.
join.inviteExpired: This invite is no longer valid. Reply to your invite mail and we send you a fresh one.
join.refusedTotpCode: That code did not match. Type the code your app shows now; it changes every 30 seconds.
join.expiredOpen: Sign in with the email address and password you just chose, and setup picks up where you left off.
join.sentContinuing: Your address is confirmed. Continuing here…
join.account: I’m <name>,</name> at <email>,</email> with a password of <password></password>.
join.step_verify_lead: We need to know {email} reaches you before you choose a plan or connect a mailbox. Open the link we sent, or ask for a fresh one.
join.verifyWhy: It is the address we would use to reach you about your account, and the only way back in if you ever lose your passkey and your recovery codes.
join.expiredNote: The setup session lasts five minutes and this one has expired.
join.planTrial: {part, select, chosen {Start 14 days on <plan></plan>.} payment {No card} other {Start your 14-day trial.}}

joinInvite.invited: You're invited to this ohmail server
joinInvite.account: I’m <name>,</name> at <email>,</email> with a password of <password></password>.
joinInvite.signInHere: This is your sign-in for this server, not a new email address.
joinInvite.badToken: This invite link does not work any more. Links work once and expire, so ask the person who invited you for a new one.
joinInvite.tokenSpent: This invite was already used for {email}. To use another email address, ask the person who invited you for a new link.
joinInvite.missingLine: Ask the person who invited you to send the link again.
joinInvite.missingNote: The invite’s secret part is missing from the address. It usually gets lost when a link is copied by hand.
joinInvite.unavailableBody: This page is not connected to a server.

pairLanding.title: Pairing this device
pairLanding.missingTitle: Scan the code on your computer
pairLanding.missingBody: Your mail lives on your own computer, and this page reads it from there. Open ohmail on that computer and scan the pairing QR code it shows you — the code's secret part never travels any other way.
pairLanding.revokedBody: This device's pairing has ended — it was signed out from your computer, or it expired. Scan a fresh QR code from ohmail on that computer to pair again.
pairLanding.badToken: Pairing codes work once and expire. Show a fresh QR code in ohmail on your computer and scan it again.
pairLanding.footer: ohmail · your mail, on your own computer
pairLanding.outboxNotKept: Changes made while your computer is out of reach are not kept on this device — this browser refuses to store them. Keep this page open until they are sent.
pairLanding.signOutBody: Signs this browser out of your computer. Your mail stays on your computer.
pairLanding.signOutConfirm: Sign this browser out? Changes not yet sent from here and unfinished drafts in this browser are discarded.
pairLanding.signedOutBody: You signed this browser out, and your computer ended its session. Scan a fresh QR code from ohmail on that computer to pair again.
pairLanding.signedOutOwedBody: You signed this browser out. Your computer could not be reached, so it is told the next time this page reaches it. Scan a fresh QR code from ohmail on that computer to pair again.
pairLanding.signedOutNotToldBody: You signed this browser out, but your computer could not be told and this browser could not keep a note to tell it later. To end the session there, remove this browser from the devices in ohmail on your computer.

verify.confirmWith: Confirm my email address with password <blank></blank>.
verify.codeIs: The code from my email is <blank></blank>.
verify.line: It is the password you chose when you signed up. We ask for it here so that only you can confirm this address.
verify.refusedLink: This link has expired or was already used. Sign in with your email address and password and we send you a new one.
verify.refusedPassword: That is not this account’s password. Use the one you chose when you signed up.
verify.doneBody: Sign in to carry on where you left off.
verify.handedOff: Setup carries on in the tab where you started it.
verify.signIn: Sign in for a new link
verify.unavailableBody: This copy of ohmail has no server attached, so there is nothing to confirm against.
verify.footer: Two factors protect this account: your password and a passkey or authenticator app.

authorizeDesktop.title: Sign the app in?
authorizeDesktop.grantsMail: It can read and send your mail, as this browser can.
authorizeDesktop.grantsLong: It stays signed in until you sign it out.
authorizeDesktop.grantsRevoke: Settings › Devices signs it out at any time.
authorizeDesktop.safety: If you were not expecting this, close this page.
authorizeDesktop.expired: That request is no longer open. It may have expired, been used already, or been started in another window.
authorizeDesktop.expiredHint: Start again from the app on your computer.
authorizeDesktop.overWhy: It may have expired, been used already, or been started in another window.
authorizeDesktop.doneBody: Go back to it on your computer.
authorizeDesktop.unavailableBody: This copy of ohmail has no server attached, so there is no account to sign in.
authorizeDesktop.footer: Nothing is signed in until you press the button.

approve.title: Sign in ohmail on this computer.
approve.onlyYours: Confirm only if it is yours and you started this.
approve.otherNetwork: This request came from a different network address than this browser.
approve.notOffered: This server does not approve computer sign-ins from a browser.
approve.doneBody: It signs in on its own.
approve.deniedBody: The request is gone and that computer stays signed out.
approve.expired: This request has expired. Start again from your computer.
approve.denied: This request was declined in the browser.
approve.notFound: There is no sign-in request here for this account.
approve.missing: This page opens from the ohmail app on your computer.
approve.busyRetrying: The server is busy · retrying in {seconds} s.

approve.signInUnchecked: Your sign-in could not be checked just now. Reload this page to try again.

linkDesktop.title: The desktop app needs a code.
linkDesktop.typeIt: Type it into the app window that sent you here.
linkDesktop.fallback: If nothing opens, type it into “Code from the browser” in the app.
linkDesktop.safety: Nobody from ohmail will ever ask you for this code. It is a way into your mail.
linkDesktop.cancelledNothingMinted: No code was created. You cancelled before the check finished.
linkDesktop.signInFirst: Sign in to ohmail in this browser, then open this page again from the app.
linkDesktop.unavailableBody: This copy of ohmail has no server attached, so there is no account to link.
linkDesktop.busyRetrying: The server is busy · retrying in {seconds} s.

resume.revokedBody: You were signed out on this browser.
resume.reusedBody: This browser used a sign-in that had already been renewed, as a restored backup, a copied browser profile or a stolen sign-in would. ohmail ended it everywhere. If you did not restore or copy anything, change your password.
resume.expiredBody: Your sign-in on this browser has expired.
resume.pendingBody: You signed out on this browser.
resume.busyBody: The server is busy right now. This browser has not been signed out.

accessLock.title: This account is not active.
accessLock.kept: Your mail and settings are kept. Nothing has been deleted, and your mail is on your own server either way.
accessLock.keptLine: Your mail and settings are kept.
accessLock.keptNote: Nothing has been deleted, and your mail is on your own mail server either way.
accessLock.unpaid: A payment failed and the time to fix it ran out on {date}.
accessLock.stopped: ohmail has stopped organizing this account.
accessLock.stoppedUntouched: ohmail has stopped organizing this account, and your mailbox is untouched.
accessLock.erasure: The rules, Screener decisions and settings ohmail keeps for you are erased on {date}. Your mail is in your mailbox and is not part of that.
accessLock.erasureHeld: An operator is holding this account, so nothing is erased while that stands. Write to support@ohmail.app if this is unexpected.
accessLock.erasureUnknown: Nothing has been erased. Your mail is in your mailbox and is not ours to delete.
accessLock.subscribeHint: Opens your account page: choose a plan, pay, come back here.
accessLock.neverStartedLead: 14 days free, no card. Choose a plan on your account page to start the trial, then connect your mailbox.
accessLock.neverNote: Choose a plan on your account page to start the trial, then connect your mailbox.
accessLock.startTrialHint: Opens your account page: choose a plan, start the trial, come back here.
accessLock.mintFailed: The account page could not be opened just now. Try again in a moment.
accessLock.mintUnverified: The account page needs a confirmed address. Open the link in the mail we sent when you signed up.
accessLock.unverifiedEmail: The account page needs a confirmed email address. Open the link in the mail we sent when you signed up.
accessLock.pending: The payment is not confirmed yet. As soon as it is, this continues on its own — nothing to do.
accessLock.pendingLine: The payment is not confirmed yet.
accessLock.pendingNote: As soon as it is, this continues on its own.
accessLock.moveOutHint: Downloads your rules, Screener decisions and settings as one file, which your own install reads when it takes over this mailbox.
accessLock.moveOutLine: One file with your rules, Screener decisions and settings, which your own server reads when it takes over this mailbox.
accessLock.moveOutFailed: The file could not be downloaded just now. Try again in a moment.
accessLock.deleteHint: Erases everything ohmail keeps, today rather than on the date above. Your mailbox is not touched.
accessLock.deleteHintOn: This erases everything ohmail keeps today, not on {date}. Your mailbox is not touched.
accessLock.deleteHintUndated: This erases everything ohmail keeps, today. Your mailbox is not touched.
accessLock.deleteHintNeverStarted: This removes the account, and you can sign up again at any time.
accessLock.openInBrowser: Open ohmail.app in a browser to manage or delete this account.
accessLock.erasedBody: Its copy of your mail is gone from this browser. The mail on your mail server is untouched.
accessLock.erasedUntouched: The mail on your mail server is untouched.
accessLock.erasedGone: Its copy of your mail is gone from this browser.
accessLock.erasedBlocked: Another ohmail tab is still holding the copy open, so it could not be removed yet. Close ohmail's other tabs and reload this page.

subscribed.title: Back to ohmail.
subscribed.body: ohmail opens your account again as soon as the payment is confirmed.
subscribed.note: If ohmail is an app on your home screen, close this window and switch to it.

stepUp.door: This continues right here once your second factor is verified.
stepUp.codeLabel: Six-digit code from your authenticator app
stepUp.recoveryLabel: One of the recovery codes you saved
stepUp.codeHint: Each code works once. If you just signed in with one, wait for your app to show the next.
stepUp.locked: Too many attempts failed, so try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
stepUp.badCode: That code didn't work. Codes expire quickly, so try the newest one.
stepUp.badPasskey: That passkey wasn't accepted. Try again, or use another method.
stepUp.badRecovery: That recovery code didn't work. Each code works once, so try another one from your list.
stepUp.slowed: Checks for this account are slowed after many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
stepUp.refused: The check did not go through, so try again in a moment.
stepUp.cancelledNothingRan: Nothing ran, because you cancelled before the check finished.
stepUp.expired: Your confirmation window has closed. Sign in again, then retry.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.mail: Your mail is on your own mail server, in the folders ohmail filed it into. This deletes ohmail’s copy.
deleteAccount.gone2: Every mailbox you connected, with the password stored for it.
deleteAccount.gone3: Every message, conversation, contact and note ohmail copied, with your rules, Screener decisions and workflows.
deleteAccount.gone4: Your passkeys, authenticator and recovery codes, and every session on every device.
deleteAccount.goneWhen: At once and in one step. The copy in this browser is wiped too.
deleteAccount.kept1: One billing record with a random id and no name: the credit ledger, the subscription and the link to the payment provider. Financial records have to be kept (Art. 17(3)(b)).
deleteAccount.kept2: What our staff looked at or changed on the account, under the same id.
deleteAccount.kept3: Hashes of your sign-in tokens, up to 400 days after they expire, so an app still signed in is told the account is gone.
deleteAccount.keptSelfHost: An account row with a random id and no name, and hashes of its sign-in tokens for up to 400 days after they expire, so an app that still holds one is told the account is gone.
deleteAccount.keptSub: Your subscription is cancelled at once. Days already paid for are not refunded.
deleteAccount.backups: Backups expire on their own schedule.
deleteAccount.factorBody: The next successful factor erases the account for {email}. There is no further step after it.
deleteAccount.cancelledNothingErased: Nothing was erased. You cancelled before the check finished.
deleteAccount.doneBody: You are signed out on every device, and your mailbox is untouched.
deleteAccount.doneNote: Open it in any mail app and the ohmail folders are still there.
deleteAccount.doneSubFailed: We could not reach the payment provider to cancel your subscription. Your account is erased, but the subscription may still be active. Write to support@ohmail.app and we cancel it.
deleteAccount.erasedMirrorBlocked: The mail kept in this browser could not be removed, because another ohmail tab is holding it open. Close ohmail’s other tabs and reload this page.
deleteAccount.signedOutBody: Deleting an account needs a live session on that account.
deleteAccount.unavailableBody: This copy of ohmail has no server attached, so there is no account to delete.
